verdict.rationale: Milvus ships a documented public API via pymilvus SDK (MilvusClient) with clear docs for search, filtering, multi-vector, RBAC, and collection management, plus a Python SDK and REST/gRPC access implied by client libraries; an official MCP server further exposes this API for natural-language/agentic driving. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and independent hands-on confirmation of API stability/versioning.
